tips.title: Check the animal's health
tips.text: Look for bright eyes, a clean nose and a steady walk. Skip animals that limp, cough or refuse food.

tips.title: Confirm the age
tips.text: A cow should be at least 2 years old and a goat at least 1 year. The teeth are the most reliable sign.

tips.title: Care for it until Qurbani
tips.text: Give clean water, fresh grass and shade. Keep the animal calm and avoid long, stressful transport.

breeds.name: Sahiwal
breeds.text: Heat tolerant and calm. Popular for its heavy build and good meat yield.

breeds.name: Local Deshi
breeds.text: Hardy and well suited to our climate. Loved for its natural taste and fair price.

breeds.name: Black Bengal
breeds.text: Small, active and known for tender meat. A good choice for smaller families.
